hotPath.name: /assets/index-*.js
hotPath.reason: The page: the code of easel. No frame shows without it. It changes with each build.

hotPath.name: /assets/vendor-*.js
hotPath.reason: React, Tinker and the other packages that the page imports. It changes only when a package changes, so a new build of easel loads it from the cache.

hotPath.name: /assets/rolldown-runtime-*.js
hotPath.reason: The small loader that joins the page and the vendor chunk (0.6 KB). The page cannot start without it.

hotPath.name: /assets/index-*.css
hotPath.reason: The look of the canvas and the shells: with no CSS, no frame has its box.

hotPath.name: /api/pictures/*
hotPath.reason: A frame that is not live shows its picture, so no frame is a white box (canvas-speed.md 6). Each is at half size, also at 3%: a task of Checkpoint D asks for the size that the view needs (canvas-speed.md 4).

hotPath.name: /api/fonts/inter-5.3.0/inter-latin-wght-normal.woff2
hotPath.reason: Inter, the font of the design system (SPEC-design.md). The text shows at once in the system font (font-display: swap), so it holds back no frame. One file of 48 KB for Latin letters, kept a year.
